comment: Dependency vulnerability policy enforced by scripts/audit-gate.mjs (see docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md).
comment_allowlist: Allowlist entries suppress a finding only while their `expires` date (YYYY-MM-DD) is valid. A missing, malformed, or past date fails closed: the entry stops suppressing and is itself a violation, so an accepted risk cannot outlive its review (SBOM-P2-010).

severityPolicy.comment: prod findings are enforced at or above blockAtOrAboveProd; dev findings are only *reported* unless they reach blockAtOrAboveAnyScope. This deliberately keeps the build green for genuinely unpatchable dev-tool advisories while making them visible in the CI job summary.

allowlist.reason: No patched version exists (<0.0.0). Reached only through @storybook/nextjs > node-polyfill-webpack-plugin > crypto-browserify > browserify-sign > elliptic and is never shipped in the production images. Tracked in docs/DEPENDENCY_POLICY.md; remove once upstream publishes a fix or Storybook drops the polyfill chain.
